benchmark: P2 AMD node: click → screen and click → sound through the portal-brokered session, Radeon 780M vs RTX 4090, same browser and output

client.browser: Claude app's built-in browser, Chromium 152.0.7977.130 (Electron), on the M4 Pro
client.note: Probe started by hand with the pane in front; runs where the pane was not painted are marked

path: WebTransport, AV1, 60 fps, test-pattern environment; the stream follows the pane's element (1192×1440, coded 1216×1440 on radeonsi)

runs.node: cha-amd (Radeon 780M, LXC on Proxmox, video clocks held high)
runs.note: the pane showed a black picture during this run

runs.node: iolinux (RTX 4090, GPU shared, another session's cha/streamer:dev)

note: Click → shown on the 780M (16.0-16.7 ms) matches the 4090's best in this browser (15.8 ms, p15). Click → sound varies 19 ms between sessions on the same node: the test pattern's 20 ms sound-server buffer puts each click at a different point of its refills, so one run per node can't separate them.
